name: @nyuchi/mzizi-console
description: app.mzizi.dev — the Mzizi console. Astro in front, Rust/Dioxus islands behind.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && vp run astro:build
scripts.check: pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:rust
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --all-targets
